title: Atrevida Partners: Best Multi-Strategy Offshore Fund US 2016
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
Based in New York, Atrevida Partners is an asset management firm focusing on alternative investment strategies directed away from traditional asset classes.

Serving high-net-worth-individuals and clients ranging from family offices to endowments, the company’s size allows it to take a more opportunistic stance by investing in lesser-known territories and niche-orientated funds. Thanks to the firm’s highly skilled risk management experts, these funds provide clients with better returns than traditional investment strategies, such as broad equity or fixed-income indices.

Atrevida’s Multi-Strategy Offshore Fund is a wonderful example of the company’s adeptness in this field. With over $116m in assets under management in this strategy, the fund enjoyed a 44.1% return on investment since its inception in 2007. The fund has consistently outperformed its risk-adjusted benchmarks, using the skills of its management team, a range of investment tools, and a series of successful strategies.

Not only does this fund of funds (FOF) invest in hedge funds, but also in a broad variety of financial instruments in order to profit from new opportunities, hedge risks, and maintain a varied portfolio; maximising profitability at every corner. This approach allows the firm to react quickly to global markets in order to flexibly rebalance its portfolio much faster than traditional FOFs.

Few hedge fund managers can successfully balance such a broad array of strategies and territories in order to consistently achieve such impressive risk-adjusted returns. The CFI.co judging panel declares Atrevida Partners winner of the 2016 Best Multi-Strategy Offshore Fund US Award.
